goal: Accept the new auth token format while still accepting legacy tokens during the migration window, with zero auth downtime.
criteria: Legacy tokens continue to be accepted throughout the migration window
New-format tokens are accepted after the flag is enabled
Auth integration tests pass for legacy, new, and mixed tokens

migration_rollback.mitigation: Dual-read until the rollback window closes; flag-gated writer switch

access_control.mitigation: Both formats validated with the same signing key material

phases.objective: Add new-format reader behind the dual-read path
criteria: New-format tokens parse without affecting legacy reads

phases.objective: Flag-gate the new-format writer and add mixed-token tests
criteria: Mixed-token integration tests pass with the flag off and on
